### `get_folder_templates`

**Get Folder Templates** · `GET /api/v2/team/{team_id}/folder_template` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View the Folder templates available in a Workspace.

Use this endpoint to retrieve Folder template IDs for use with the [Create Folder From Template](folders.md#create_folder_from_template) endpoint.

Template IDs are returned with a `t-` prefix (e.g., `t-7162342`). Pass the full ID including the prefix as the `template_id` path parameter when creating a Folder from a template.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_id` | path | number | yes | Workspace ID |

### `get_list_templates`

**Get List Templates** · `GET /api/v2/team/{team_id}/list_template` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View the List templates available in a Workspace.

Use this endpoint to retrieve List template IDs for use with the [Create List From Template in Folder](lists.md#create_list_from_template_in_folder) and [Create List From Template in Space](lists.md#create_list_from_template_in_space) endpoints.

Template IDs are returned with a `t-` prefix (e.g., `t-15363293`). Pass the full ID including the prefix as the `template_id` path parameter when creating a List from a template.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_id` | path | number | yes | Workspace ID |
